title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines): Repeat-Increase Surcharge
content:
**Repeat-increase surcharge.** The repeat-increase surcharge is 15 percent where two or more limit increases were recorded on the policy in the 12 whole months before the increase is signed, 7.5 percent where exactly one was, and nothing where none was.

A limit increase recorded on the policy is a limit-increase endorsement on this Excess Flood policy's servicing record, counted by the date it was recorded; it is counted when that date lies fewer than 12 whole months before the day the new increase is signed. Limit decreases are not counted.

Every surcharge percentage set on an increase is added into one increase loading, which acts once on the added limit's charge at the layer rate: that charge is multiplied by one plus the increase loading.

| Limit increases recorded in those 12 whole months | Repeat-increase surcharge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 15 percent |
| exactly 1 | 7.5 percent |
| none | nothing |

**Window boundary (hypothetical).** For an increase signed on the 5th of a month, an increase recorded on the 6th of the same month a year earlier lies 11 whole months back and is counted; one recorded on the 5th lies 12 whole months back and is not.
